name: Mercury NZ Limited
summary: Mercury NZ Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, trading, and sale of electricity and related activities in New Zealand. The company operates through Generation/Wholesale, Customer, and Other segments. It operates nine hydro power stations with total of 4,452 GWh hydro generation; five geothermal stations with total of 2,622 GWh geothermal generation; and five wind stations with total of 1,995 GWh wind generation. The company also provides its multi-product utility services to residential, small-to medium-sized business, industrial, and wholesale customers. In addition, it provides piped natural gas and bottled LPG; broadband, mobile, and moving house services. …
